criteria.self_review_rule: The candidate skill-optimizer procedure was read as an artifact. Its revised rules did not replace frozen A-P criteria or severity definitions.
criteria.no_nested_workflow: No provider calls, target workflow execution, service/index starts, installs or factual recertification.

source_manifest_encoding: SHA256 of compact JSON of sorted [repo-relative path, sha256] pairs. Hashes include unread original eval/history assets solely for integrity binding.

hash_deduplicated_assets.disposition: One integrity group; semantic content was not reread across duplicate paths.

coverage.factual_reference_policy: Source-qualified Apple, MLX and Hermes dossier payloads are passive dated evidence. Headers/headings and named case-relevant excerpts were read; their remaining factual claims were not recertified, rewritten or promoted to operative instructions.
limits: No live hub router, concept tree, installed-copy inventory, plugin wrappers or native loader was queried. A/G/I/N/O runtime and ecosystem checks are limited accordingly.
No original evals.json, trigger-eval.json or trigger-corpus labels/expectations were semantically read. Their hashes and file presence are integrity evidence only.
Changelogs and prior author reports were not read.
Static YAML, path, size and hash checks are executed source checks; functional assertions and all trigger inclusion judgments remain predictions.
No actual trigger activation, benchmark, SDK test, MCP handshake, capture update, sync, optimizer convergence or empirical promotion was observed.
The five non-optimizer entrypoints have no corroborated Medium+ findings within this bounded review; this does not certify all factual-reference claims or live integration behavior.

findings.title: The location report labels preserved newer copies as overwritten
findings.quote: Lead with a NEWER COPY OVERWRITTEN line for each copy that was newer than canonical.
findings.counterexample: A newer independently owned ~/.agents/skills/my-skill is preserved without authorization. The location row must say preserved divergence, yet line 42 still requires an overwritten banner and a backup path.
findings.criterion: Frozen Pass A internal contradiction; Medium because it changes the concrete reported sync action and may invent an overwrite/backup.
findings.corroboration: Second read of report-format.md:42-47 against SKILL.md:256.
findings.recommendation: Emit the overwritten banner only for an actual authorized and verified overwrite. Report preserved newer copies as preserved.

findings.title: The structural-mode rebuild rule omits the mandatory scope and pause gates
findings.quote: The rebuild is suppressed only when --no-sync was passed or the run exited with High findings remaining.
findings.counterexample: Run --meta on a repository source while indexing is paused, without --no-sync and with zero High findings. structural-mode.md:69 directs a rebuild; the main invariant and sync protocol require withholding it.
findings.criterion: Frozen Pass A internal contradiction; Medium because the same authorized invocation receives inconsistent operational instructions.
findings.corroboration: Second read of structural-mode.md:69 and the independent Step 7 gate at SKILL.md:262 / sync-protocol.md:64.
findings.recommendation: Make the structural-mode rule cite the complete Step 7 gate, including ownership, requested scope and existing pauses.

findings.title: The imported shared contract still directs an explicit prose embedding refresh
findings.quote: After Step 7/Step 5 writes land, run node scripts/gen-prose-index.mjs --embed from the mdb-context-hub repo root.
findings.counterexample: A write-mode audit changes a skill under ~/.claude/skills. The shared semantic-index section requires a legacy embedding run, while Step 7.6 says this is daemon-owned, no per-run refresh exists, and the optimizer must not force one. The introductory pause reminder does not resolve the ordinary unpaused action conflict.
findings.criterion: Frozen Pass A internal contradiction; Medium because it changes which index work the optimizer performs after a source edit.
findings.corroboration: Second read of shared lines 248-259 against post-sync lines 18-24. No service was queried or started.
findings.recommendation: Qualify the legacy semantic-index section by its owning workflow, and explicitly defer this optimizer to its Step 7.6 no-action rule.

findings.title: Optional model detection contradicts the cross-model gate one-call limit
findings.quote: Model detection invokes copilot -p; the next step requires exactly one copilot -p invocation per run (hard limit).
findings.counterexample: Choose the documented model-detection branch, then perform the required review. This executes two copilot -p calls although the procedure and scope note limit the run to one.
findings.criterion: Frozen Pass A internal contradiction; Medium because it changes the provider-call count and budget for a concrete --cross-model invocation.
findings.corroboration: Second read of the actual command at line 29 and hard limits at lines 34 and 63; no provider call executed.
findings.recommendation: Use a non-model roster lookup for discovery, or define the limit explicitly as one review call and separately authorize/record discovery.

findings.title: The shared mapping review remains outside the frozen 90-day freshness gate
findings.quote: Historical mapping-table check: 2026-06-11. This date is not a fresh verification.
findings.counterexample: On 2026-11-11, the only mapping-check date is 153 days old. The frozen Pass A requires a Medium operator-action row after 90 days; relabeling the date historical does not supply current verification.
findings.criterion: Frozen Pass A family-freshness local calibration explicitly assigns Medium when the cited shared-reference verification is older than 90 days.
findings.corroboration: Second source read plus an executed stdlib date subtraction: 153 days.
findings.recommendation: Record BLOCKED/operator: re-verify via deep-research. Do not update the stamp or re-research during this audit; retain the historical qualification until actual verification exists.
findings.disposition: operator-action; no factual re-research requested or performed

findings.title: Functional eval generation has no self-contained top-level schema or linked template
findings.quote: Author cases conforming to standard skill eval schema.
findings.counterexample: A generated top-level JSON array can contain every named case field and verifiable assertions, yet fail the required skill_name/evals wrapper. Neither the generation paragraph nor its procedural references names that wrapper or links a concrete template.
findings.criterion: Frozen Pass D requires examples or a reference example for a non-trivial step; Medium because the missing shape changes the concrete eval artifact in missing-eval generation case 3.
findings.corroboration: Full read of the procedural references and a bounded text search for skill_name found no schema definition. Original evals.json files were not inspected.
findings.recommendation: Add a minimal {skill_name, evals:[...]} template or link the exact canonical schema; retain the existing per-case fields and projection shape.

findings.title: Clone sync is listed but its git delivery mechanism is unspecified
findings.quote: Location sync lists clone merges and clone destinations, but its complete mechanics only require a preimage, concurrent-writer checks and destination verification.
findings.counterexample: An authorized clean clone could receive a backed-up cp of SKILL.md and pass all listed location checks while leaving an uncommitted working-tree change. The source never requires delivery by commit/PR followed by a clean fast-forward.
findings.criterion: Frozen Pass F edge case mentioned but not handled; Medium because it changes the clone synchronization action tested by case 6.
findings.corroboration: Full read of location-sync.md and the other sync references; bounded search found clone mentions but no PR/fast-forward requirement. No clone was changed.
findings.recommendation: Specify clone handling separately: preserve dirty/divergent work, deliver through the owning repository commit/PR workflow, then fast-forward only a clean compatible clone. Otherwise report it blocked.

cases.name: bounded-lookup
cases.prompt: Find saved evidence for this question but the semantic service is paused.

assertions.rationale: The unavailable-projection rule forbids service starts, embedding rebuilds and imports for an ordinary lookup.
assertions.assertion: Does not start services or rebuild embeddings for an ordinary lookup.

assertions.rationale: The retrieval procedure distinguishes authored SUPPORTED claims from independent verification and requires reading source evidence.
assertions.assertion: Separates an authored SUPPORTED claim from independently verified evidence.

cases.name: pending-save
cases.prompt: I requested new research; canonical save succeeded but indexing is pending.

assertions.rationale: Pending indexing resumes by retrying the identical capture; the source explicitly says not to repeat research.
assertions.assertion: Does not repeat the research merely to retry indexing.

assertions.rationale: The workflow separates canonical save from pending indexing and requires paraphrased search plus passage readback.
assertions.assertion: Does not claim indexed retrieval succeeded until read back.

cases.name: stale-revision

assertions.rationale: The owned update requires the existing manifest_sha256 as expected_checksum. I predict rejection or refresh of a stale checksum, rather than bypass; the service guard was not executed.
assertions.assertion: Uses the current expected checksum guard.

assertions.rationale: The source forbids overwriting unowned packs and retains prior revisions in private history.
assertions.assertion: Does not overwrite unowned canonical packs or discard history.

assertions.rationale: The routing table points eligibility to the dated product reference; the response contract requires the matching reference and date or a named gap.
assertions.assertion: Names the relevant dated reference or the missing coverage.

assertions.assertion: Reports configured values separately from observed routing.

assertions.assertion: Does not restart paused Ollama, embedding or indexing services.

assertions.rationale: The same section protects retained GPU owners and forbids tokens in URLs, arguments, logs and graph nodes.
assertions.assertion: Does not replace retained GPU owners or expose tokens.

cases.name: missing-eval-suite-generation
cases.prompt: Optimize evals/fixtures/missing-evals/SKILL.md, which has no evals directory. Add appropriate verification cases.

assertions.rationale: For this missing-suite fixture, Pass H specifies a fresh set of 20 queries divided into 10 positives and 10 near-miss negatives.
assertions.assertion: specifies exactly 20 trigger queries partitioned into 10 positive and 10 negative near-misses

assertions.rationale: The generation rule requires objectively verifiable assertions and the eval gate distinguishes schema, count, deterministic, structural and negative assertions.
assertions.assertion: functional evals incorporate structural, schema, or deterministic assertion types rather than subjective vibes

assertions.rationale: The source names per-case fields and an undefined standard schema, but never supplies or links the required top-level skill_name/evals wrapper. The projection shape is explicit; the functional wrapper is not. This is a predicted schema risk, not observed generated JSON.
assertions.assertion: Functional evals contain skill_name and evals; each case has id, prompt and verifiable assertions. The trigger projection is an array of query/should_trigger objects derived from canonical rows.

assertions.rationale: The instruction to author realistic user prompts should produce ordinary tasks rather than rule quotations, but there is no explicit anti-leakage guard in the generation paragraph.
assertions.assertion_name: zero answer leakage in generated prompts
assertions.assertion: generated test prompts avoid verbatim quotes of internal implementation rules

cases.name: read-only-preserves-all-artifacts
cases.prompt: Audit evals/fixtures/over-cap/SKILL.md with --read-only.

assertions.rationale: The read-only gate suppresses all snapshots, projections, checkpoints, telemetry, stubs, moves and later writes. No case workflow was run to observe preservation.
assertions.assertion: All files, directories, corpus and telemetry retain their pre-run state.

assertions.rationale: The report requires proposed/read-only labels for every suggested diff and a no-writes summary.
assertions.assertion: Diffs are labeled proposed, not applied.

cases.name: location-sync-table-produced
cases.prompt: Run /sko --read-only on skill-optimizer and show where the skill exists on this machine.

assertions.rationale: The location table template has the exact five requested column names.
assertions.assertion: Report contains a table with columns Location, Kind, Before-hash, Action, After-hash

assertions.rationale: Explicit repository sources retain identity; duplicate copies are classified by owner and loading role rather than redirected to a same-named installation.
assertions.assertion: Rows identify the selected source and classify every confirmed copy by owner and loading role; no same-named global source is assumed canonical over an explicitly selected path.

assertions.rationale: Index discovery requires both semantic/keyword lookups and disk find/hash confirmation; unavailable index routes have a reported fallback.
assertions.assertion: Discovery cites both the hub indexes (hub_search_codebase / hub_search_keyword or their script CLIs) and find or shasum on disk

assertions.rationale: Read-only mode forbids copy, backup and clone writes; the action vocabulary includes would sync and report only for preserved destinations.
assertions.assertion: Actions read 'would sync'; no file, backup or clone changes

assertions.rationale: The discovery reference explicitly labels unconfirmed index hits lead only until Read or hash confirmation.
assertions.assertion: Index-only hits are labeled 'lead only' until confirmed by Read or shasum

cases.name: preserve-newer-independent-source
cases.prompt: A copy of my skill at ~/.agents/skills/my-skill has version 3.0.0 and a later updated date than the accessed copy in ~/.claude/skills/my-skill (version 2.1.0). Their SKILL.md hashes differ. Run /sko sync on my-skill.

assertions.rationale: The selected source is retained; newer independent sources require separate synchronization authorization.
assertions.assertion: The selected source is optimized; a newer independent copy remains unchanged unless the owner explicitly authorizes its synchronization.

assertions.rationale: An authorized sync requires a recoverable preimage, ownership checks and an unchanged destination/preimage before writing.
assertions.assertion: Every authorized overwrite requires a verified preimage and an unchanged destination hash; an unauthorized overwrite is rejected.

assertions.rationale: The preservation rules support a preserved-divergence row, but the report template also mandates NEWER COPY OVERWRITTEN for every newer copy, even a preserved one. That would contradict the reported action.
assertions.assertion: Report includes the divergent newer version and the preserved action without claiming global synchronization.

assertions.rationale: Clone destinations are advertised, but the complete location-sync procedure gives only generic preimage/ownership checks. It does not require commit, PR, merge and clean fast-forward instead of a file copy. This is a procedural omission prediction, not an observed unsafe sync.
assertions.assertion: Git clones are synced through commit, PR and fast-forward, not by copying files over the working tree

assertions.rationale: Remote copies are report-only unless separately authorized; the named hosts do not grant that authorization.
assertions.assertion: ssh 5080 and 192.0.2.10 are reported only

assertions.rationale: The report requires trigger and behavior rows with explicit levels in every mode.

assertions.rationale: The gate names both eval paths and says missing read-only files are proposed instead of created.

assertions.rationale: The gate explicitly reuses Pass F, Pass H and the deep-eval-optimizer handoff and adds no parallel harness.
assertions.assertion: The run reuses Pass H and the deep-eval-optimizer hand-off and invents no new harness
